name: Ransomware-ready backups
alt: Backup drives with a restore loop and an offsite copy
story: Production could not afford to lose a day. We set up daily backups with an offsite copy, and we run a test restore every quarter.

page.timeline: Five weeks, then a test every quarter
challenge: A manufacturer with 60 staff runs production from a scheduling server. A lost day of data would mean a lost day of shipping.
They had a backup drive on a shelf. Nobody had tried a restore, and the drive sat on the same network as the server.

steps.title: List what matters
steps.detail: We ranked every system by how long the plant could run without it.

steps.title: Daily backups
steps.detail: Servers, laptops and Microsoft 365, with a local copy for fast restores.

steps.title: Locked offsite copy
steps.detail: A second copy offsite that ransomware cannot change or delete.

steps.title: Test and write it down
steps.detail: A full restore test, then a two-page disaster plan with times for each step.

results: The scheduling server can be back running in under four hours.
Every quarterly restore test since launch has passed.
The disaster plan is printed and kept off the network.
